cc:Work.dc:title: Source-defined Nordic section widths
cc:Work.dc:description: August 2015 cruise snapshot; section order is geographic, not a time series. Circles: primary 0.04 m/s threshold. Dashed spans: 0.02/0.04/0.08 m/s sensitivity, not errors. Squares: alternate ~1.3 Sv transport-conserving tube; 10% flux tolerance is not width uncertainty. Source: Kolås & Fer (2018), doi:10.5194/os-14-1603-2018, Table 2, p1611 · CC BY 4.0. No annual extrema, fixed depth layer or mapped width edges inferred. Independent OSW graphic.
